title: melampodium gracile var. oblongifolium
intro: Melampodium gracile var. oblongifolium, commonly known as the "Cuban Buttonbush", is a plant species in the Asteraceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from various health issues, such as reducing inflammation, fever, and cough. The plant's health benefits are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Melampodium gracile var. oblongifolium include sesquiterpene lactones and other flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
